overview: SSK Public School — a full-stack school management website and ERP dashboard with dedicated portals for parents, students, and teachers, plus QR attendance and student ID card generation.
features: Admin dashboard with student management and CRM
Fees, salary, attendance, results, mock tests, finance modules
Parent portal: attendance, fees, results, notices, teacher messaging
Student portal: mock tests, results, assignments, notices, attendance
Teacher portal: homework upload, attendance marking, marks entry, salary slips
QR code attendance scanning and generation
Student ID card generator with QR code
